how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-arathi-highlands-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:635:obj:0: Find the crystal from your vision.
rows.quest:635:details:0: This shard pulses as you hold it...
rows.quest:635:details:1: BYou feel a sense of pleading coming from the shard, as if someone is trying to communicate, someone who desperately needs your help.
rows.quest:635:details:2: BA vision appears in your mind - of the northern mountains of Arathi, and of a brilliant crystal jutting from the earth there.
rows.quest:635:details:3: BYou feel drawn to that place.
rows.quest:635:completion:0: This crystal pulses, as if a living force is trapped within it.
rows.quest:636:details:0: This book tells the tale of an elemental princess, ⟦E1⟧, and of her imprisonment deep underneath the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:636:details:1: BIt also tells of a secret outcropping of crystals in the highlands. These crystals, the Shards of ⟦E1⟧, are a window to the princess' prison.
rows.quest:636:details:2: BIf a brave soul found the Shards of ⟦E1⟧, the perhaps ⟦1⟧ could speak with her...
rows.quest:639:obj:0: Get the Sigil of Strom for Zengu in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:639:details:0: In ancient times, trolls fought against the Arathorian Empire and our most capable adversary, Lord Ignaeus of Strom, named Trollbane. He rode into battle wielding Trol'kalar--troll slayer, in their ancient tongue.
rows.quest:639:details:1: BBut now the sons of Trollbane are weakened, their stronghold brought to ruin.
rows.quest:639:details:2: BThe sword is protected by several sigils that were divided among the survivors of Stromgarde, and we must retrieve them.
rows.quest:639:details:3: BThe first was taken by the ⟦E3⟧, one of their men in Stromgarde should have it.
rows.quest:639:completion:0: Excellent, mon. That's a good start to collecting the sigils we'll need to remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb.
rows.quest:640:obj:0: Retrieve the 5 Sigil Fragments from the defenders in Stromgarde, and bring them to ⟦E4⟧'gan in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:640:details:0: Thoras Trollbane's tomb is protected by three sigils--the first of which you retrieved from the ⟦E3⟧. The other two will be harder to get, as they're held by the firmly entrenched Stromgarde militia.
rows.quest:640:details:1: BThe sigil of Thoradin was divided into five pieces by Thoras' son, Galen, and dispersed among the Stromgarde defenders. Retrieve the pieces and bring them to ⟦E4⟧'gan, the troll shaman, he will be able to bind them into the complete sigil.
rows.quest:640:completion:0: Ah, you need me to reconstruct this sigil? It shouldn't be too difficult... all the pieces seem to be here and the magical structure will be easy to reform.
rows.quest:640:completion:1: BYou might want to close your eyes.
rows.quest:641:obj:0: Bring the restored Sigil of Thoradin to Zengu in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:641:details:0: The reconstruction worked flawlessly. The sigil can now be used to unlock the seal on Trollbane's tomb. Return it to Zengu, no doubt he has additional tasks for you to complete.
rows.quest:641:completion:0: We're halfway to being able to remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb. We are not exactly sure where the third sigil is, as its holders seem to move around Arathi quite a bit, but I have faith that you'll be able to find it.
rows.quest:642:obj:0: Gather 12 Motes of ⟦E1⟧, then bring them to the Iridescent Shards in Drywhisker Gorge.
rows.quest:642:details:0: My name is ⟦E1⟧. I am a princess of the earth, and my captors, the giants, have trapped me deep beneath the ⟦E2⟧. These crystal shards are the only way I can speak with the surface world.
rows.quest:642:details:1: BPlease help me. Allies of the giants, the Drywhisker Kobolds, have a shard like this one in their Drywhisker Gorge, to the east. To power the cluster, you must gather Motes of ⟦E1⟧ from the kobolds and apply them to it.
rows.quest:642:completion:0: Ah! You activated these shards. Already I feel more myself!
rows.quest:642:completion:1: BBut alas, I am still far from free...
rows.quest:643:obj:0: Retrieve the Sigil of Arathor and return it to Zengu in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:643:details:0: Though they can barely be said to control Stromgarde, let alone the whole of ⟦E2⟧, the human prince trots the remnants of his cavalry over the countryside. I can't understand why he does it, but who understands the way the humans think, hm?
rows.quest:643:details:1: BWhatever his reasoning, more importantly, he has given one of the sigils to Lieutenant Valorcall, their cavalry leader. Locate him and bring his sigil back to me.
rows.quest:643:completion:0: Losing their cavalry leader will prove a large blow to the Stromgarde defenders. Better yet, it means that we are only one sigil from being able to have Trol'kalar for ourselves.
rows.quest:644:obj:0: Kill Prince Galen Trollbane and bring the Sigil of Trollbane to Zengu in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:644:details:0: The final of the sigils needed to unlock the tomb of Thoras Trollbane is held by his son personally. He resides deep within Stromgarde, in a chapel in the militia-held districts. Prince Galen is well protected and no slouch of a warrior himself, so this task could prove most difficult.
rows.quest:644:completion:0: Quite a day this is, ⟦3⟧. The blood of Trollbane will no longer haunt my people, and the sigils needed to take Trol'kalar are in our possession. Soon, very soon, we will strike against the hated trolls of Zul'Gurub.
rows.quest:645:obj:0: Retrieve Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb in Stromgarde.
rows.quest:645:details:0: What's this? With the four sigils brought together, they have formed together to create one sigil. There can be no doubt that this will be able to break the wardings placed upon Trollbane's tomb.
rows.quest:645:details:1: BTrollbane's remains are entombed in the Sanctum behind the chapel in Stromgarde. Retrieve Trol'kalar.
rows.quest:645:completion:0: Matching the lines on the face of Trollbane's tomb with the glowing lines of the Sigil of Ignaeus, a flash of light consumes the Sigil, and the legendary sword Trol'kalar is released from the stone hands' grip.
rows.quest:646:obj:0: Deliver Trol'kalar to Zengu in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:646:details:0: The light slowly fades, the sword Trol'kalar, held within a stone sheath has been released.
rows.quest:646:completion:0: For generations, the forces of Strom and Arathor ravaged the trolls. Now their greatest weapon is in our hands. Our inching progress in the steamy forests of Zul'Gurub will be no more.
rows.quest:646:completion:1: BYour assistance has been great, ⟦4⟧, and the ⟦E5⟧ trolls are indebted to you.
rows.quest:646:completion:2: BI will be sure that the sword is delivered to ⟦E6⟧ at Grom'gol.
rows.quest:651:obj:0: Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding.
rows.quest:651:obj:1: BBring them to the Stone of Inner Binding.
rows.quest:651:details:0: Four Stones of Binding are scattered throughout Arathi. These stones keep me pinned beneath the earth.
rows.quest:651:details:1: BTo unlock them you must unlock the strongest: the Stone of Inner Binding. And to do that, you must gather keys from the other three.
rows.quest:651:details:2: BThese stones are watched by guardians, but if you are clever, or lucky, you may find ways to ⟦E7⟧ them.
rows.quest:651:completion:1: BYou have done it! You opened the Stones of Binding! I can feel the shackles about me loosen, and freedom draws ever closer.
rows.quest:651:completion:2: BYou are a noble ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧. My rescuer!
rows.quest:652:obj:0: Find and kill Fozruk. Bring the Rod of Order to the Keystone in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:652:details:0: Opening the Stones of Binding loosened much of my confinement, but a lock still holds me chained. It is the Keystone you see among this circle of stones. And the key is held by one of my captors, the stone watcher Fozruk.
rows.quest:652:details:1: BYou must obtain that key, which the stone watchers call the Rod of Order, from Fozruk and use it to open the Keystone.
rows.quest:652:details:2: B⟦7⟧, you have done so much to aid me. Just a little more...and my gratitude will shake the very foundations of the earth!
rows.quest:652:completion:0: You place the rod in the keystone. And a shudder is felt beneath you...
rows.quest:653:obj:0: Speak with Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern of ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:653:details:1: BFree! I AM FREE! I am free to gather strength, hidden from my captors. For if they faced me now they would surely overpower and again imprison me.
rows.quest:653:details:2: BBut in time I will confront the giants, and they will regret their wardship of me!
rows.quest:653:details:3: BYou are a noble ally, ⟦9⟧. I will need your help again in time. When I am ready, I will need you to summon me to the surface.
rows.quest:653:details:4: BSpeak with Gerrig Bonegrip. He is in ⟦E8⟧, in a shop of the Forlorn Cavern. He knows how I can be summoned.
rows.quest:653:completion:0: The Lady told me of your coming, ⟦10⟧. You are welcome in my abode for you, like I, serve a higher cause.
rows.quest:655:details:0: It is still clear to me, like yesterday... So many years without hope, with wood and steel to bind me to this terrible place. Then finally, finally! There was the Warchief. Doomhammer in his midnight plate, his warhammer held high.
rows.quest:655:details:1: BIt was... too terrible... That the blow of a coward would strike down our greatest hero. From behind he charged on his horse, and then his lance ran him through... I fell to my knees. What hope was there? What hope is there...
rows.quest:655:completion:0: Ah, Gor'mul you speak of. Yes, from what he says, it seems he has never recovered from the death of Doomhammer.
rows.quest:655:completion:1: BGor'mul was a captive here when Thrall and Orgrim fought to free the camp, but as the earth shook and our brethren escaped, he was left behind. He wandered alone and lost for years without direction or hope, until we returned to establish ourselves here in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:656:obj:0: Go to the Shards of ⟦E1⟧, summon her and defeat her.
rows.quest:656:obj:1: BGather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:656:details:0: You must defeat ⟦E1⟧ before she grows in strength. If you do not, then once she has gathered enough power she will challenge her captors! There are some who think they can control her, but if she can be controlled then why did the giants chain her in the first place??
rows.quest:656:details:2: BTo defeat her, summon her at the Shards of ⟦E1⟧ where you first spoke with her. Defeat her and gather her Eldritch Shackles, then bind them to the Shards of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:656:details:3: BDo that, and she will again be trapped.
rows.quest:656:completion:0: As the eldritch shackles are placed around the Shards, an unhuman wail is heard from far below. The scream is followed by a roar.
rows.quest:656:completion:1: BThe Shards of ⟦E1⟧ no longer invoke feelings of warmth and security as they once did. Now they pulse with an open menace... as if the thing beneath them holds ill will toward the surface.
rows.quest:662:obj:0: First Mate Nilzlix wants you to retrieve the Charts and Logs from the Maiden's Folly and the Spirit of Silverpine.
rows.quest:662:details:0: O'Breen led the ships into the cove. We were certain this is where the treasure could be found. The Harbinger docked safely but as the Maiden's Folly and Spirit of Silverpine approached the tides began to lower. Strangest thing I've ever seen!
rows.quest:662:details:1: BThose two ships ran aground into something... some sort of temple in the reef. They sank so quickly, was quite a tragedy.
rows.quest:662:details:2: BWe need to retrieve their Logs as well as their Charts before we leave. We can't leave that information behind for prying eyes!
rows.quest:662:completion:0: Knowing this information is secure will bring some ease to the command in Booty Bay. Well done, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:663:obj:0: Talk to Captain O'Breen in Faldir's Cove.
rows.quest:663:details:0: Lolo sees a tiny ⟦12⟧! Always on the lookout, Lolo is!
rows.quest:663:details:1: BWelcome to Faldir's Cove. Captain O'Breen said we'd only be here for a few hours. Just long enough to gather the treasure and get back to Booty Bay.
rows.quest:663:details:2: BBut Lolo thinks we're going to be here a lot longer than that. We lost the other two ships from our formation. Poor Spirit of Silverpine and Maiden's Folly. On the bottom of the sea they rest now!
rows.quest:663:details:3: BLolo suggests you talk to Captain O'Breen if you plan on sticking around here.
rows.quest:663:completion:1: B'Twas a horrible mess. Seahorn will have my ship if he finds out what went down.
rows.quest:663:completion:2: BOne of the Professor's contraptions indicated the lost treasure was near this cove. I brought the Harbinger in to dock and signaled for the Spirit of Silverpine and Maiden's Folly to follow suit.
rows.quest:663:completion:3: BThen the sea rumbled. The tides lowered and the two ships crashed into the reef.
rows.quest:663:completion:4: BIt's not just a reef. Something's down there....
rows.quest:663:completion:5: BHelp my crew out and you'll be rewarded handsomely.
rows.quest:664:obj:0: Captain Steelgut in Faldir's Cove wants you to kill 10 Daggerspine Raiders and 3 Daggerspine Sorceresses.
rows.quest:664:details:0: Argh, 'tis a horrible life. I should be in a watery grave right now, not sittin' here by the fire, breathin' fresh air.
rows.quest:664:details:1: BThe crew tried so hard to save my beautiful Maiden's Folly. Bless the boys, bless their hearts.
rows.quest:664:details:2: BO'Breen made it to shore safely but we weren't so lucky. The seas just sank on us, I swear.
rows.quest:664:details:3: BOne second we're afloat and the next water is rushin' in. And those beasts! Killed all the survivors. Horrible naga scum. I went black and ended up here, saved.
rows.quest:664:completion:1: BThose scum deserved what they got. While nothin' will ever bring me ship or me crew back, the death of those naga gives me some solace.
rows.quest:665:obj:0: Escort Professor Phizzlethorpe to the cave and back.
rows.quest:665:details:0: Now that we are full-fledged Blackwater Raiders it is our job to help Mr. O'Breen locate the lost elven treasure.
rows.quest:665:details:1: BIt is next to impossible to find the gems in the dark sea without aid. The doctor has constructed some goggles that will help. He needs the goggles charged with the energy derived from the enchanted stone in the cave just up the hill.
rows.quest:665:details:2: BBut the cave is cursed! When we get close, we get ambushed. Defend me and I can harness the energy from the stone into the goggles.
rows.quest:665:completion:0: The goggles work perfectly now! Well done, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:666:obj:0: Doctor Draxlegauge in Faldir's Cove wants you to collect 10 Elven Gems and return the Goggles of Gem Hunting once you are done.
rows.quest:666:details:0: The treasure has been on the sea floor so long that the gems have calcified into thick stone. But the power harnessed in these goggles will allow you to locate them easily.
rows.quest:666:details:1: BA little gnomish ingenuity goes a long way!
rows.quest:666:details:2: BSo borrow the Goggles of Gem Hunting, ⟦15⟧, and see if you can collect some of the lost treasure for Captain O'Breen.
rows.quest:666:details:3: BI'd swim down there myself but...um...well, I have important scientific business to tend to up on the safe, dry land....er, yeah.
rows.quest:666:completion:0: Most superb, ⟦16⟧! The Captain will be very pleased! And just wait until word gets back to Fleetmaster Seahorn!
rows.quest:667:obj:0: Protect Shakes O'Breen during the attack.
rows.quest:667:details:0: This is bad. It seems the Daggerspines are amassing for an attack.
rows.quest:667:details:1: BNaga are known for their ruthlessness in battle. They will keep attacking until I am dead.
rows.quest:667:details:2: BI don't value my own life above that of my crew members, but you must help to defend me. The crew will not be able to make it back to Booty Bay without my knowledge of the seas.
rows.quest:667:details:3: BThe naga will be coming from the sea. I need you to remain up here with me to fend off the attack. Man the cannon and drive them back.
rows.quest:667:completion:1: BWe could not have done it without you, ⟦18⟧.
rows.quest:667:completion:2: BWe'll be heading out as soon as the tide rises. If you weren't such a promising hero I'd offer you a place on my crew. But I can tell you have bigger fish to fry.
rows.quest:667:completion:3: BEven if you are a puny ⟦19⟧....
rows.quest:668:obj:0: Take the Elven Gems to Captain O'Breen.
rows.quest:668:details:0: Let's not leave Captain O'Breen waiting. He'll want to see these gems first hand. After all, that's why we're here!
rows.quest:668:details:1: BAnd after a few weeks of consorting with these pirates, the professor and I have realized the last thing that's good for our health is to be caught hanging on to their treasure.
rows.quest:668:completion:0: So the little gnomes proved their worth after all? I knew we kept those ankle biters around for a reason!
rows.quest:669:obj:0: Take the Sample Elven Gem to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:669:details:0: Fleet Master Seahorn will want to hear about our find at once.
rows.quest:669:details:1: BBut as you can see, we're not in much of a position to get out of here. Not only is the tide too low, but those damned creatures we disrupted are keeping a close eye on our movements.
rows.quest:669:details:2: BYou can be of great service to the Blackwater Raiders if you can get word to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay that we discovered the treasure and are working on extracting more. Take him this sample as proof.
rows.quest:669:completion:0: Ah, leave it to good old Shakes O'Breen! I knew that he was the right Captain for the mission!
rows.quest:670:obj:0: Deliver Seahorn's Letter to Shakes O'Breen in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:670:details:0: Say, ⟦21⟧, you seem to be an adventurous type. My fleet is stuck in Booty Bay until we can restock.
rows.quest:670:details:1: BThere are some heavy things brewing here and abroad and I need to get some top secret correspondence to Shakes O'Breen who is tied up off the Arathi coast.
rows.quest:670:details:2: BCan I trust you to deliver this message safely and in confidence?
rows.quest:670:completion:0: Thank you for making such a long and perilous journey. You have the gratitude of the Blackwater Raiders.
rows.quest:671:obj:0: Get 10 Bloodstone Amulets for ⟦E4⟧'gan in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:671:details:0: I have felt a strangeness in the air... a feeling that simmers in my blood. I had my suspicions. I set off to find the source of my unease and discovered to the west, at Northfold Manor, the residual traces of demonic summoning. As I got close, my blood began to boil and the rage within me grew.
rows.quest:671:details:1: BOn the ground I spied an amulet of bloodstone, used to assist in demonic summoning. The one I found was depleted, however. I'll need another to examine, but I dare not return to the manor. Can you bring me some?
rows.quest:671:completion:0: It will take some time for me to ascertain the true intentions of the ⟦E3⟧, but their obvious association with dark, demonic magic troubles me. I will tell you when I know more.
rows.quest:672:obj:0: Acquire 10 Highland ⟦E9⟧ Eyes from Highland Striders and Highland Thrashers for ⟦E4⟧'gan in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:672:details:0: We tried to settle him in, cheer him up, telling him stories of our mighty city at ⟦E10⟧ in ⟦E11⟧, but nothing would move him.
rows.quest:672:details:1: BTales of our young Warchief, Thrall, who bears the armor and hammer of Orgrim... but, perhaps... Perhaps! A demonstration of our newly found shamanistic magic would give him new hope. It is worth a try!
rows.quest:672:details:2: BA small object we could make for him, yes... Bring me some raptor eyes, and I will see what I can do.
rows.quest:672:completion:0: Excellent. The spirits of the raptors that gave these eyes will lend strength to the bearer of this amulet.
rows.quest:673:obj:0: Retrieve Marez Cowl's Bloodstone Orb and bring it to ⟦E4⟧'gan in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:673:details:0: There is no doubt in my mind that a powerful warlock resides within the walls of Stromgarde. From time to time, using an arcane magical relic, this warlock has summoned forth terrible demons in large numbers. We must remove the source of his energy.
rows.quest:673:details:1: BFind the warlock and kill him. Bring me whatever magical object you find on his person, and I will take steps to destroy it and see that its power is not used to taint this land any longer.
rows.quest:673:completion:0: My restless nights will turn to peaceful slumber when I have destroyed this orb. Thank you, ⟦22⟧. It is a chilling reminder of the terrible power the demons held over the orcs before Hellscream released them from their curse.
rows.quest:674:obj:0: Give the ⟦E9⟧ Talon Amulet to Gor'mul.
rows.quest:674:details:0: Here, take this amulet to Gor'mul, and see if the raptors' strength can awaken the flame of the warrior that once burned through his veins.
rows.quest:674:completion:0: What is this? Polished bone. What use have I for polished bone? Will a trinket restore the ⟦E12⟧ to its glory?
rows.quest:675:details:0: <Gor'mul tosses the amulet into the ground.>
rows.quest:675:details:1: BTor'gan sent you, didn't he? Pah! Why he feels some mercy towards me I would not understand. Mercy was denied me when I was not allowed to die with my Warchief in battle. A cruel blow fate has dealt me...
rows.quest:675:completion:0: It did not work, I see. Nonetheless, I feel that showing him the power of the shamans will eventually return Gor'mul to his once proud self. The amulet's power was not great enough to show him our newfound power.
rows.quest:677:obj:0: Slay 10 Witherbark Axe Throwers, 10 Headhunters and 8 Witch Doctors, and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
rows.quest:677:details:0: The Witherbark trolls and Boulderfist ogres of Arathi are working together to rid us from this land, but we shall not meet our fates at their, or anyone else's, hand. We will slay them and show them that we, too, have a home here.
rows.quest:677:details:1: BThe trolls turned their backs to us; the ogres would use us for food and bedding if we allowed them to--these things shall not be.
rows.quest:677:details:2: BWe start our attack on the Witherbark trolls to the south of here. Slay them in droves, and only return when their camps run thick with blood.
rows.quest:677:completion:0: The signs of war are upon your garments, and sweat drips from your brow. Good, very good indeed.
rows.quest:678:obj:0: Kill 10 Boulderfist Brutes and 4 Boulderfist Magi, and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
rows.quest:678:details:0: Your strength is evident, ⟦23⟧. Now to see how you fare against a real enemy.
rows.quest:678:details:1: BThe Boulderfists have a lair to the southwest of here towards the dwarven bridge, and, if I'm not mistaken, the maulers and magi there shall present to you a greater challenge--they have done so to us thus far.
rows.quest:678:details:2: BSlay as many as you can and come to me in body when you are successful, or come to me in spirit when you fail. I shall give praise to your tenacity in battle either way.
rows.quest:678:completion:0: You are as strong as a kodo, and your lust for battle does your people proud.
rows.quest:679:obj:0: Kill 7 Boulderfist ⟦E13⟧ and 3 Boulderfist Lords and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
rows.quest:679:details:0: The head of the beast is ready to be taken off... with great force, ⟦24⟧. You have shown every sign that you are able to help us with this final mighty blow. The leaders of these attacks have made their lair within the ruins of Stromgarde, a glaring symbol of human frailty.
rows.quest:679:details:1: BFind and slay those Boulderfist lords and their lackey shaman who would try and drive us from these lands.
rows.quest:679:completion:0: You do your people proud, ⟦25⟧. The threat has been greatly lessened, and I am sure we will begin to thrive here in the Highlands.
rows.quest:680:obj:0: Slay Or'Kalar and bring his Head to Korin Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
rows.quest:680:details:0: You serve my husband well, ⟦26⟧, but he does not know why Hammerfall is under attack.
rows.quest:680:details:1: BOr'Kalar, Mug'thol's pawn in Stromgarde, has an intense hatred for my husband, and wishes nothing more than my husband's death for defeating him years ago.
rows.quest:680:details:2: BMy auguries tell me that Or'Kalar has laid a trap for my husband, so I have hidden signs of the ogre's presence from him.
rows.quest:680:details:3: BMy husband will rush off foolishly if he learns of the ogre's whereabouts and I would ask for your help in slaying the creature.
rows.quest:680:completion:0: You have done me a great service, ⟦27⟧. Know that my husband's life and the safety of Hammerfall has been protected for another day because of your deeds. Please take this as a reward for your courage.
rows.quest:681:obj:1: BReturn to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:681:details:0: We are fighting a war for Stromgarde, and we are losing. The ogres, the ⟦E3⟧ and we have divided our once great city, and each faction battles the other into a bloody stalemate.
rows.quest:681:details:1: BBut our forces dwindle while our enemy grows.
rows.quest:681:details:2: BWe need help from the town of ⟦E14⟧, but supplies are difficult to receive while the ⟦E3⟧ holds territory between us.
rows.quest:681:details:3: BGo to the ⟦E3⟧ base in Northfold Manor and slay them. Then, perhaps, pressure on our supply trains will lessen and more will get through.
rows.quest:681:completion:0: Very good, ⟦28⟧. With the deaths of those ⟦E3⟧ members we should have an easier time receiving supplies from ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:681:completion:1: BPerhaps our cause yet has hope.
rows.quest:682:obj:0: Bring 7 Stromgarde Badges to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:682:details:0: The ⟦E3⟧ in Stromgarde do battle with our contingent of militia there. In order to urge the rabble to fight our more disciplined troops, the ⟦E3⟧ leaders have placed a bounty on our soldiers, awarding gold for each Stromgarde Badge gathered off killed militiamen.
rows.quest:682:details:1: BWe want those badges retrieved - we cannot allow the cutthroats to take trophies from our brave fallen!
rows.quest:682:details:2: BEnter the ⟦E3⟧-controlled area of Stromgarde and hunt them for our badges.
rows.quest:682:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦29⟧. We will inform the families of these fallen soldiers that they were killed in battle.
rows.quest:682:completion:1: BIt will be grim news to bear, but it is better than the uncertainty of a missing loved one.
rows.quest:684:obj:0: Bring Marez's head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:684:details:0: A bounty has been placed on the head of Marez Cowl, a high-level advisor and operative of the ⟦E3⟧. She was last seen within the ⟦E3⟧ controlled territory of Stromgarde.
rows.quest:684:details:1: BBounty may be collected from Captain Nials.
rows.quest:684:details:2: BBe warned: Marez is a skilled and cunning Warlock, known for her trafficking with demons. Extreme caution is advised when hunting her.
rows.quest:684:completion:0: You took down Marez Cowl? Well done, ⟦30⟧. Well done indeed!
rows.quest:684:completion:1: BMarez menaced our Stromgarde defenders, and it is rumored she was an emissary between the ⟦E3⟧ and some other, darker power. We are glad to see she'll longer ply her powers against us.
rows.quest:685:obj:0: Bring Otto's Head and Falconcrest's Head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:685:details:0: The Stromgarde Militia has placed bounties on the heads of Lord Falconcrest, and his bodyguard Otto. Falconcrest heads the ⟦E3⟧'s efforts in the ⟦E2⟧, and his death would cause a major disruption in those efforts.
rows.quest:685:details:1: BHis bodyguard Otto, although not a strategic target, is a fierce opponent and has killed dozens of our defenders.
rows.quest:685:details:2: BTheir bounties may be collected from Captain Nials.
rows.quest:685:completion:1: BHere is your reward, ⟦31⟧. I am happy to pay it.
rows.quest:687:details:0: Theldurin the Lost was once a member of our order, the Twilight's ⟦E15⟧. But he lost his mind and scorned our teachings. And before he fled from us, he stole the scroll of ⟦E1⟧! We could not catch him, but rumors say he hides in the ⟦E16⟧, gibbering and mad.
rows.quest:687:details:1: BTo bring the Lady back to us, you must find the scroll. And to do that, you must find Theldurin.
rows.quest:687:completion:0: Hello. Hello, hello hello hello hello HELLO!
rows.quest:687:completion:1: BI'm sorry - wait, no I'm not! Don't be rude!
rows.quest:687:completion:3: BBut...sometimes being crazy is my only solace.
rows.quest:688:details:1: BFree! I AM FREE! I am free to gather strength, hidden from my captors. For if they faced me now they would surely overpower and again imprison me.
rows.quest:688:details:2: BBut in time I will confront the giants, and they will regret their wardship of me!
rows.quest:688:details:3: BYou are a noble ally, ⟦33⟧. I will need your help again in time. When I am ready, I will need you to summon me to the surface
rows.quest:688:details:4: BSpeak with Zaruk in Hammerfall. He knows how I can be summoned.
rows.quest:688:completion:0: Welcome, ⟦34⟧. The Lady has informed me of your coming, and if we are to bring her back to the surface then we have much to discuss...
rows.quest:691:obj:0: Find 10 Witherbark Tusks, 4 Witherbark Medicine Pouches and a Shadow Hunter Knife for Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:691:details:0: Archmage Malin sent Skuerto and I here to collect reagents for him. I was at a loss as to how I was going to collect the items, but now that you're here, I think my problem's solved.
rows.quest:691:details:1: BI need the following: Witherbark tusks, Witherbark medicine pouches and a shadow hunter knife.
rows.quest:691:details:2: BCould you find those for me? The Witherbark live to the southeast of Arathi.
rows.quest:691:completion:0: Incredible! I can see why Malin asked you to come join us - very well done indeed!
rows.quest:691:completion:1: BAt this rate, Skuerto and I will be headed back to ⟦E17⟧ in no time at all.
rows.quest:691:completion:2: BI believe my dwarven companion is back from scouting Boulderfist Hall; go speak to him when you're ready.
rows.quest:691:completion:3: BIt looked as though he might have had a bit of a scuffle with the ogres. Don't mention that to him, though; he's very sensitive about criticisms to his skills at scouting.
